INPUT_INVALID.message: Some of your input is not valid.
INPUT_INVALID.hint: Check the highlighted fields and try again.

SPEC_INVALID.message: The video script has a problem.
SPEC_INVALID.hint: Undo the last change or regenerate that scene.

SLOT_TOO_LONG.hint: Shorten it so it reads clearly on video.

STYLE_UNAVAILABLE.message: This style is not available right now.
STYLE_UNAVAILABLE.hint: Pick another style from the library.

RENDER_FAILED.message: The video could not be exported.
RENDER_FAILED.hint: We will retry automatically. If it keeps failing, try another style for this scene.

RENDER_TIMEOUT.hint: Try again in a few minutes or shorten the video.

QA_FAILED.message: Some scenes did not pass the visual quality check.
QA_FAILED.hint: Review the flagged scenes and shorten the text or change the layout.

VOICE_FAILED.message: The voice-over could not be created.
VOICE_FAILED.hint: Try again or choose another voice.

AI_FAILED.message: The assistant could not handle this request.

QUOTA_EXCEEDED.message: You have used all credits in your plan.
QUOTA_EXCEEDED.hint: Upgrade your plan or wait for the next cycle.

PAYMENT_REQUIRED.hint: Update your payment method in Plan & billing.

NOT_FOUND.hint: It may have been deleted or the link is wrong.

FORBIDDEN.message: You do not have permission to do this.

RATE_LIMITED.message: You are going a bit fast.
RATE_LIMITED.hint: Wait a few seconds and try again.

INTERNAL.hint: We have logged the problem. Please try again later.
